name: Speed lines
summary: Full-frame manga focus lines converging on a subject, or horizontal motion streaks, flickering; for dashes and reveals.

params.name: x
params.note: focus x the lines converge on

params.name: y
params.note: focus y the lines converge on

params.name: dir
params.note: radial focus lines or horizontal streaks

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at

params.name: inner
params.note: clear radius around the focus in px

params.name: flicker
params.note: 0 steady, 1 lines grow and shrink a lot

params.name: seed
params.note: change for a different set of lines

params.name: color
params.note: line colour; default the style ink

author: krakujs
